purpose: Track whether the active God Mode objective has real feature or governance improvement evidence across every required topic before completion is claimed.

topics.newImprovement: God Mode dashboard surfaces expose completion audit, run state, handoff, staging, changelog, module coverage, and ecosystem lanes.
topics.remainingGap: Commit, push, and CI evidence are still missing.

topics.newImprovement: Goals now have a governance evidence ledger that requires acceptance evidence, validation duties, evidence links, and rollback posture.
topics.remainingGap: Final staged commit evidence and CI pass evidence are still missing.

topics.newImprovement: Repos now have a health manifest that tracks repo lanes, publish safety, plugin posture, CI posture, and protected work boundaries.
topics.remainingGap: Branch integration, commit boundary staging, push, and CI evidence are still missing.

topics.newImprovement: Docs now connect architecture manifesto, five-layer operating map, ADR workflow, quality gates, release readiness, and God Mode governance surfaces.
topics.remainingGap: Generated reports and governance docs must remain current after final staging.

topics.newImprovement: Agents now have lane status for God Mode Developer, Focus Mode, Master Prompt, Security Review, and GitHub Workflow capability boundaries.
topics.remainingGap: Agent changes still need commit, push, and CI evidence.

topics.newImprovement: Security is represented through enterprise gates, release readiness, SSH/cloud safety contracts, and no-secret/no-destruction policy constraints.
topics.remainingGap: CI security evidence and external GitHub enforcement evidence are still missing.

topics.newImprovement: AI policy requires intent, risk, owner, audit, rollback, policyVersion, and human approval markers for high-risk automation.
topics.remainingGap: AI policy still needs current CI evidence before completion claims.

topics.newImprovement: Rollback is required by enterprise gates, work-package sections, release readiness, and completion audit blockers.
topics.remainingGap: Rollback has governance evidence, but no final commit or CI rollback-readiness proof.

topics.newImprovement: Validation now has a plan, local validation log, run state, runtime evidence, and quality governance linkage.
topics.remainingGap: Validation remains incomplete until final staged checks and CI evidence exist.

topics.newImprovement: Handoff now records changed surfaces, validation status, risks, rollback, next commands, protected user work, and staging review posture.
topics.remainingGap: Handoff remains open until commit hash, push result, and CI pass evidence exist.

completionBlockers: No commit hash exists for the full reviewed package.
completionRule: The broad God Mode objective remains not-complete until every topic has improvement evidence, required gates pass, unrelated user work is protected, and commit/push/CI evidence exists.
